homeCaseStudy.description: This is the type of story we see in every intake. Name changed for privacy — results are fully documented.
pills: Successfully secured ICT Business Analyst role
ACS assessment passed on first try
homeCaseStudy.quote: "I lost $8,000 AUD with another agency, got no visa, wasted my time, and almost gave up on the 482 visa pathway entirely. That's when I found RedBridge. During the very first meeting, they showed me employer profiles and a detailed future career plan for free. It was completely different from other agencies."
homeCaseStudy.paragraph1: Wang holds a business degree from Monash but failed to accumulate any full-time work experience required for a skills assessment during his two-year post-study work visa. Carrying the weight of past failures and skepticism toward migration consulting firms, Wang approached us. During the free consultation, our team presented him with employer profiles in the ICT sector: company names, current sponsorship status, and specific available roles. With a clear understanding, Wang decided to trust us and proceed.
homeCaseStudy.paragraph2: Soon after, within the next <highlight>three months</highlight>, he accumulated <highlight>400+</highlight> hours of paid project work experience (as a Business Analyst), signed ACS-compliant logbooks, and secured a high-quality, stable employer. His 482 visa was lodged in the following fourth month. He is currently on his way to <highlight>permanent residency</highlight> via the 186 transition stream.
